newsitem.title: USA: MatriDigm wins Year 2000 deal, to go through Zitel.
newsitem.headline: MatriDigm wins Year 2000 deal, to go through Zitel.

text.p: MatriDigm Corp said on Thursday it won a contract from the state of Nevada to provide them with Year 2000 conversion services and it expected to contract almost exclusively through Zitel Corp and BRC Holdings Inc.
The MatriDigm Advanced Process 2000, a factory conversion series, would be used to the so-called "find, fix and test" portion of the project. the company said.
Zitel shares closed up 7-1/2 at 37-1/2, while BRC Holdings shares were up 7/8 at 37-1/2 and the overall stock market fell sharply.
"After a great trial-run with MAP2000, it was very clear that we wanted MatriDigm involved in our conversion effort," said Marlene Lockard, Director of Department of Information Services in Nevada.
"MatriDigm offers us a real solution that will potentially save us millions of dollars."
While MatriDigm expected to contract almost exclusively through Zitel and BRC, it said other technology associate agreements were being negotiated and several were in executive review.
MatriDigm was not immediately available to comment on the potential value of the deal and Zitel declined to comment on the deal's value.
